newsitem.title: USA: Biomet, DePuy settle patent suits.
newsitem.headline: Biomet, DePuy settle patent suits.

text.p: Biomet Inc and DePuy Inc said Friday they have resolved five federal patent lawsuits in a settlement that did not involve an exchange of money.
Biomet and DePuy, both orthopedic implant manufacturers, said the deal resolves lawsuits involving four DePuy patents and four Biomet patents.

The five cases, which were pending in three U.S. district courts, are being dismissed under a royalty-free cross-licensing arrangement between DePuy and Biomet under which each can continue to manufacture and distribute their respective current products.

The settlement enables each company "to focus its attention on its general competitive positions within the medical device marketplace while addressing even newer technologies for better orthopedic patient care," Biomet and DePuy said in a statement.
